Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the summary. Im sorry to hear the incidents caused revenue impact. We can offer a time-limited operational program to support your migration, with the following guardrails proposed:

- Duration: 90 days from the agreed start date (pilot window)
- P1 acknowledgment: within 15 minutes 24/7 (monitoring and paging)
- Primary on-call: dedicated rotation with overlap 06:00-22:00 PT; night coverage via rotating async + immediate escalation to secondary on-call
- Phone/SMS fallback: yes, verified mobile contact for the on-call engineer and a named manager escalation (we will provide contact details once approved)
- Escalation path: on-call engineer -> on-call manager -> senior incident lead (names provided) -> exec on-call if unresolved after 2 hours
- Reporting: weekly incident digest and post-incident writeups for P1s
- Billing: temporary premium to be added to invoice or charged to the deal (we can include it as an amendment)

Two asks from our side before we lock this in:
1) Ben (cc) to approve a temporary on-call coverage shift and confirm any cost/comp implications.
2) Laura to review the runbook and confirm we can attach the extra metrics/log retention for the pilot window.

Im attaching a starter "P1 escalation matrix" draft for internal sign-off. If Ben/Laura can review today, I can send a short addendum and the named contacts to you by EOD.

Appreciate the flag — well move fast.

— Vivek
